gameplay_visual_link: The keep and moon orient camera position across the stage; the continuous deck gives a stable floor-contact and spacing reference. Lanterns mark stage edges and depth but do not obscure fighters or change combat state.
archetype_adaptation_note: The catalog has no Japanese-fortress archetype. The nearest castle-role archetype is used only for its scene-role and budgeting vocabulary. Do not import gothic architecture, stained glass, god rays, torch-cycle palettes, or its signature techniques; Suzaku retains its original Japanese fortress identity.
selected_archetype_definition: Grounded Japanese fortress at night, moon and mountain/cloud depth, repeatable rail and wood deck, clear fighting floor and original warm lantern accents.

top_candidates.why_fit: Only catalog entry with castle gameplay role and dramatic vertical architecture; the stage's keep silhouette can serve as a scale anchor.
top_candidates.risks: Strong thematic mismatch. Reuse no Gothic motifs or technique cards without a new scene-specific owner and budget.

top_candidates.why_fit: Moon, clouds and wide atmospheric sky are relevant to the far depth plane.
top_candidates.risks: No fortress/fighting-stage role; could make the scene too airy and weaken the grounded platform.

rejected_candidates.reason: Rejected as a literal visual style; retained only as a structural castle-role reference.
Rejected as the selected whole-scene archetype because floating-island scale and cloud-sea motifs conflict with the grounded fortress stage.
